monitor_contract.strict_paths: All originals/**, protocol/**, startup/final receipts and evidence stdout/stderr/JSONL/JSON are retained. Files may grow during live scan, but disappearance is an error. Once observed strict path must not disappear; preserve its identity/size ledger sufficiently for final check. Never waive missing original merely because scan no longer lists it.
monitor_contract.volatile_rule: Only FileNotFoundError/errno.ENOENT during enumeration/lstat of the declared SQLite exact files or stage-owned cache/tmp descendants can be skipped while writer is live. Record relative path, syscall/phase, errno2, UTC and monotonic scan bracket. Never swallow EACCES/EIO/ENOTDIR or unknown errors. Missing originals/unknown paths/symlink -> fail-stop.
monitor_contract.walk_rule: Use lstat/no symlink following with explicit os.walk/scandir error handling; avoid silent os.walk onerror suppression. Missing volatile directory descendant is also a recorded live-scan race; monitored root unexpectedly absent after launch is strict failure. Pre-creation absent raw before full is separately NOT_CREATED, not a scan anomaly.
monitor_contract.live_snapshot: Every live sample is NON_ATOMIC_CONCURRENT_SCAN with started/finished monotonic+UTC, observed_bytes/files, observed volatility events and completeness relative to enumeration. Nonzero skipped paths mean an observed lower/partial sum, never exact current total. Even no skips is sequential sampling, not a continuously enforced instantaneous cap. Do not infer zero for missing volatile entries.
monitor_contract.growth_and_self_logs: Growing stdout/stderr/JSONL/cache files are measured at per-file lstat times. Record that resource-observations current row and race records are appended after scan; count them on subsequent/final scan, never call self-observing total exact. Logging remains append-only/bounded by output cap. No recursive self-count retry loop.
monitor_contract.limits: Retain product every-blob strict raw limit/fsync and checkpoint RSS; supervisor continues free disk/treeRSS/wall/output checks. Observed sum exceeding cap stops; tolerate only expected live transient misses with visible limitations, do not claim skipped-byte hard bound. If accounting cannot remain bounded or unknown IO error occurs, stop.
monitor_contract.terminal: After owned child/descendants gone and live monitor streams flushed/closed, perform strict quiescent inventory of raw and stage output: no ENOENT skips for enumerated files, count every extant file, reject symlinks/other errors, verify retained strict files. Previously skipped volatile paths now absent may be explicitly absent, not errors; enumerate current final set. Do not reopen DB. Name this complete quiescent inventory at its recorded boundary, not atomic live accounting.
monitor_contract.audit_self_exclusion: Final inventory precedes its own result/manifest receipts; declare exact excluded final receipt paths, write them once, record their byte sizes/hash in outer capture or separate receipt. Never hide logs/cache/DB from counted trees or imply recursive self-inclusive final size. Apply final resource cap including newly written final receipt sizes with bounded allowance within unchanged cap.
monitor_contract.read_output: Do not use max(0,total-final minus initial) to offset new bytes by disappeared input/cache files. Existing frozen raw separately<=16GiB and unchanged; direct count this read evidence directory+readout+read-runtime-cache+read-tmp as read new output<=2GiB. Stage-specific caches/tmp make this partition exact in scope. Record complete overall totals separately.
